description: This file defines the class A2uiMessageProcessor which processes and manages UI surface messages, including rendering, data updates, and component tree building, for a UI framework.

classes.name: A2uiMessageProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing server-to-client UI messages, managing surfaces, and building component trees.

methods.name: getSurfaces
methods.description: Returns a read-only map of current UI surfaces.

methods.name: clearSurfaces
methods.description: Clears all stored surfaces.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes an array of server messages to update UI surfaces and components.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data from a surface for a given component node and path.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets data in a surface for a given component node and path.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a relative path against a data context path to an absolute path.

methods.name: #parseIfJsonString
methods.description: Parses a string as JSON if it appears to be JSON, otherwise returns the string.

methods.name: #convertKeyValueArrayToMap
methods.description: Converts an array of key-value objects into a Map, parsing JSON strings where applicable.

methods.name: #setDataByPath
methods.description: Sets a value in a nested data model based on a slash-delimited path.

methods.name: #normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a path string, converting bracket and dot notation to slash notation.

methods.name: #getDataByPath
methods.description: Retrieves data from a nested data model based on a normalized path.

methods.name: #getOrCreateSurface
methods.description: Retrieves an existing surface or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: #handleBeginRendering
methods.description: Handles a begin rendering message, initializing surface properties and rebuilding the component tree.

methods.name: #handleSurfaceUpdate
methods.description: Handles surface update messages, updating components and rebuilding the component tree.

methods.name: #handleDataModelUpdate
methods.description: Handles data model update messages, updating the data model and rebuilding the component tree.

methods.name: #handleDeleteSurface
methods.description: Handles surface deletion messages.

methods.name: #rebuildComponentTree
methods.description: Builds the component tree recursively starting from the root component.

methods.name: #findValueKey
methods.description: Finds a key in an object that starts with 'value'.

methods.name: #buildNodeRecursive
methods.description: Recursively builds a component node and its children, resolving properties and handling circular references.

methods.name: #resolvePropertyValue
methods.description: Resolves individual property values, including references to other components, arrays, objects, and primitives.
